name: Safe deposit box access clustered around cash deposits or withdrawals
description: Box visits coincide in time with large cash deposits, cash withdrawals, or purchases of cash-like instruments at the same institution.
fp: Customers sometimes keep cash savings or valuables in boxes for ordinary reasons, and visits may coincide with legitimate banking.

sources.text: FATF, Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing in the Art and Antiquities Market, 2023
FATF, Money Laundering Vulnerabilities of Free Trade Zones, 2010
OECD, Trade-based money laundering: free trade zones and illicit trade, 2018

links.name: Safe deposit box access clustered around cash deposits or withdrawals
links.ctx: Repeated box access shortly before or after large cash transactions or foreign currency exchange.
